scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build && ( if [ -d frontend/dist ]; then rm -rf dist || true && cp -r frontend/dist dist; else echo "frontend/dist missing after build"; fi )
scripts.vercel-debug-build: node -v && npm -v && npm run build --workspace @property-management/shared && ls shared/dist && npm run build --workspace @property-management/frontend && ( if [ -d frontend/dist ]; then rm -rf dist || true && cp -r frontend/dist dist && ls -la dist; else echo "frontend/dist missing after frontend build"; fi )
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace shared
